title: Agencies deny Grusch access to programs
summary: David Grusch tells of Agencies deny Grusch access to programs, about c. 2019-2022 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: went to the agencies that wrote those reports and asked for access. And when I when when they deny you access then you know it's a thing.

plain: David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who became a whistleblower, says that between about 2019 and 2022 he went to the intelligence agencies that had written certain reports and asked for access to the programs behind them. He says they refused, and that being denied is how you know a program is real, which, if true, would mean hidden UFO programs exist inside the government.
